items.title: A complex of modules on a ringed site with a left dual is locally strictly perfect and its dual is the termwise one
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a complex of modules on a ringed site admitting a left dual in the monoidal category of complexes is locally strictly perfect, with the dual given termwise (statement lines 12999-13010). The proof (proof lines 13012-13045) decomposes the unit and counit of the duality into their components, which yields a termwise duality between F^n and G^{-n} so that the module-level description applies, and then localises so that only finitely many components are nonzero and each term becomes a direct summand of a finite free module. H2: one component decomposition followed by a localisation, written out.
